paragraph: Do you want to **participate** in that? The important thing isn't to win, but to **participate**. I hope you will **participate** in many of them.
english: to join in, to take part, to involve oneself
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تريد المشاركة في ذلك؟

paragraph: Let's **split** the bill four ways. Let's **split** up into teams. That crisis threatened to **split** the nation in two.
english: divide along a more or less straight line
arabicDesc: مثال: دعنا نقسم الفاتورة بأربعة طرق.

paragraph: Comedy is much **closer** to real life than drama. I want to get **closer** to you. He kept getting **closer** to me.
english: nearer
arabicDesc: مثال: الكوميديا أقرب إلى الحياة الواقعية من الدراما.

paragraph: He entered the **Democratic** Party but soon left it. The United States has never been a **democratic** society. The United States of America is a **democratic** country.
english: pertaining to democracy

paragraph: As far as I know, he's an **excellent** student. They have an **excellent** science program. You did an **excellent** job.
english: of the highest quality
arabicDesc: مثال: على حد علمي، هو طالب ممتاز.

paragraph: I don't know whether he was **honest** or not. He's very **honest**, so we can rely on him. He is **honest**. That's why I like him.
english: scrupulous with regard to telling the truth
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أعرف إذا كان صادقاً أم لا.

paragraph: Germany decided to not use any more **nuclear** energy. Do you think we could survive a **nuclear** attack? **Nuclear** weapons are a threat to the human race.
english: pertaining to the nucleus of an atom

paragraph: This is not a joke to be told in the **presence** of your parents. He lost his **presence** of mind at the news. This Christmas I want your **presence**, not your presents.
english: fact or condition of being present
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه النكتة لا تقال أمام والديك.

paragraph: How long have you been teaching **Spanish**? She spoke to me in **Spanish**. **Spanish** is spoken in twenty countries.
english: of or pertaining to Spain
arabicDesc: مثال: كم المدة وأنتَ تُعلم الإسبانية؟

other.meaning: of or pertaining to the Spanish language
A Romance language primarily spoken in Spain and in the Americas (noun)

paragraph: Are **corporations** or governments worse? My father holds the major interest in the **corporation**. This **corporation** is well known for its communication equipment.
english: a large company
arabicDesc: مثال: أيهما أسوأ، الشركات أم الحكومات؟

paragraph: This novel **consists** of three parts. In this video game, teams **consist** of five players. Education doesn't **consist** of learning a lot of facts.
english: to be made of certain parts
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه الرواية تتكون من ثلاثة أجزاء.

paragraph: The **protests** lasted for weeks. He said the South had good reason to **protest**. The citizens demonstrated to **protest** against the new project.
english: to make a strong objection
arabicDesc: مثال: استمرت الاحتجاجات لأسابيع.

other.meaning: A formal objection, especially one by a group (noun)

paragraph: I **convinced** him that he was wrong. We are all **convinced** that he's guilty. I thought you have **convinced** him.
english: to make someone believe, or feel sure about something
arabicDesc: مثال: أقنعته أنه كان مخطئا.

paragraph: How much would it be to **rent** this house? I want to **rent** out my house. He never forgets to pay his **rent**.
english: to grant occupation in return for rent
arabicDesc: مثال: بكم أستأجر هذا البيت؟

other.meaning: to occupy premises in exchange for rent
A tear or rip in some surface (noun)

paragraph: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first **phase**. It's not a **phase**, mom, it's my true self. This is a **phase** that many teens go through.
english: distinguishable part of a sequence
arabicDesc: مثال: تستطيع معالجة السرطان اذا أكتشف في المراحل الأولى.

paragraph: I didn't know that she was **ill**. However **ill** she is, she always works. Who told you that I was **ill**?
english: in poor health, suffering from a disease
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أعرف أنها مريضة.

paragraph: This **lesson** should be kept in mind. Maybe you'll learn a **lesson** from this. During the entire **lesson**, he counted flies.
english: section of learning or teaching
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب إبقاء هذا الدرس في الحسبان.

other.meaning: something that serves as a warning or encouragement

paragraph: The **climate** affected the growth of trees and plants. He will soon get used to the **climate** here. Is **climate** change natural or caused by human action?
english: the context in general of a particular political, moral, etc., situation

paragraph: Who was behind the **wheel** that day? Have you ever driven a four-**wheel** drive truck? He was behind the **wheel** when the accident happened.
english: a circular device capable of rotating on its axis, facilitating movement or transportation or performing labour in machines
arabicDesc: مثال: من كان يسوق ذلك اليوم؟

paragraph: She will be an **asset** to the Purchasing Department. Many people these days are **asset**-rich but time-poor. I think of love as a significant **asset**.
english: something valuable that a person or company owns; a useful quality

paragraph: It was a computer **error**. How is the **error** observed? Correct the **errors**, if there are any.
english: mistake — see also mistake
arabicDesc: مثال: كان خطأ حاسوبيّ.

paragraph: I will not give an **inch** on this point. The police went over every **inch** of this place. She knew to an **inch** where everything should be.
english: an English unit of length equal to 1/12 of a foot or 2.54 cm
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: شبر

paragraph: These projects are part of the **regional** development program. I eventually want to become **regional** manager. The European **Regional** Development Fund has financed many hotel management schools.
english: of, or pertaining to, a specific region or district
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: جهوي

paragraph: We felt the house **shake** a little. Why do people **shake** hands? **Shake** the bottle before using.
english: to cause (something) to move rapidly in opposite directions alternatingly
arabicDesc: مثال: شعرنا بالبيت يهتز قليلاً.

paragraph: You said you wanted **proof**. Well, here it is. It's so obvious that we don't even need **proof**. If you do that, it's **proof** you're free.
english: any effort, process, or operation designed to establish or discover a fact or truth
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: دليل، إثبات

paragraph: I don't have a **talent** for dealing with kids. Early in life he showed a **talent** for painting. What's a **talent** you have that you're proud of?
english: a marked natural ability or skill

paragraph: The French **flag** is blue, white and red. Our **flag** is red and black. This **flag** is very pretty.
english: piece of cloth or often its representation
arabicDesc: مثال: العلم الفرنسي ازرق و ابيض و احمر.

paragraph: How can we **generate** and distribute even more resources? We have to **generate** new revenue. We're trying to **generate** business.
english: to produce or create something

paragraph: His **delay** in coming here is due to a traffic accident. You never told us why there was a **delay**. Sorry for the **delay**, it's because of the train.
english: period of time before an event occurs; act of delaying
arabicDesc: مثال: تأخر عن الموعد بسبب حادث سير.

other.meaning: To put off until a later time (verb)

paragraph: The teacher was **threatening** us. Mom, don't **threaten** me if you can't force me. There are dangers that **threaten** both men and women.
english: to make a threat against someone; to use threats
arabicDesc: مثال: كان المدرّس يهدّدنا.

other.meaning: to portend, or give a warning of

paragraph: The paper published a profile of its new **editor**. I've applied for a job as an **editor**. The **editor** can open and save many types of files.
english: a person who edits or makes changes to documents

paragraph: I've come to visit my **girlfriend**. Do you have a **girlfriend**? Does he have a **girlfriend**?
english: a female partner in a romantic relationship
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد جئت لزيارة صديقتي.

paragraph: Please **circle** the right answer. In English class we sometimes sit in a **circle** and discuss the book we're reading. They sat in a half-**circle** around the fire.
english: a state of moving as to follow a circle
arabicDesc: مثال: رجاءً ضع دائرة حول الجواب الصحيح.

paragraph: I'll take you back home to change your **clothes**. She spends all of her money on **clothes**. I have some **clothes** for you.
english: things you wear, such as shirts and trousers
arabicDesc: مثال: سأعيدك للمنزل كي تغيّر ملابسك.

paragraph: This **electric** car is powered by batteries. My father is an **electric** engineer. His hair stood on end after the **electric** shock.
english: electrical
arabicDesc: مثال: تعمل هذه السيارة الكهربائية على البطارية.

paragraph: The room was painted **entirely** white. I agree with you **entirely**. It later turned out to be **entirely** made up.
english: completely
arabicDesc: مثال: تم دهن الغرفة كلها بالأبيض.

paragraph: He didn't even say **hello**. **Hello**, is there anyone there? **Hello**, have you already eaten?
english: a greeting (salutation) said when meeting someone or acknowledging someone’s arrival or presence
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يلقي التحية حتى.

paragraph: This could have a **massive** impact on your life. China has **massive** cities of over ten million people. The **massive** creature moved so quickly through the trees.
english: very large and heavy

paragraph: I had **plenty** of time to talk to many friends. He has **plenty** of money in the bank. We still have **plenty** of time.
english: a more-than-adequate amount
arabicDesc: مثال: كان لدي ما يكفي من الوقت كي أتحدث مع العديد من الأصدقاء.

paragraph: He took the **proper** steps to meet the situation. I was given a **proper** education by my parents. We need to have a **proper** clear-out here.
english: right and suitable

paragraph: The **upper** reaches of the river are very beautiful. The people living here belong to the **upper** class. The lower lip is bigger than the **upper** lip.
english: at a higher level, rank or position
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عليا

other.meaning: situated on higher ground, further inland, or more northerly

paragraph: This knife was very **useful** to me. Personal computers are very **useful**. The Internet is very **useful** for knowing the circumstances of each part of the world.
english: having a practical or beneficial use
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه السكين أفادتني كثيرًا.

paragraph: The space ship will get to the **moon** soon. It was a dark night, with no **moon**. The **moon** is very beautiful this evening.
english: the natural satellite of planet Earth
arabicDesc: مثال: ستصل السفينة الفضائية إلى القمر قريباً.

paragraph: What is the price of this **cap**? Where did you put the **cap** to this bottle? What kind of **cap** do you want to buy?
english: head covering
arabicDesc: مثال: ما ثمن هذه القبّعة؟

paragraph: The **vice**-principal treated me like a dog. He would leave the job to his **vice** president. Can you arrange a meeting with the **vice** president?
english: bad or immoral behaviour. (Especially often, a habit that harms oneself or others)
arabicDesc: مثال: عاملني نائب مدير المدرسة مثل الكلب.

paragraph: To be a **democrat** means to have no fear. He was a middle-of-the-road **Democrat**. He is heart and soul a **Democrat**.
english: a supporter of democracy
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ديمقراطية

paragraph: How many **chemical** elements are there in the world? Everyone knows that new **chemical** is bad for you. This **chemical** agent is used to make paper white.
english: of or relating to chemistry
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كيميائي

paragraph: She has a **soft** and clear voice. Her hands are so **soft**. The edges of shadows can be sharp or **soft**.
english: easily giving way under pressure
arabicDesc: مثال: صوتها ناعم و واضح.

paragraph: **Steel** production will increase 2% this month from last month. There are roses in front of the **steel** building. That town is the center of the **steel** industry.
english: an artificial metal produced from iron, harder and more elastic than elemental iron

paragraph: You can choose between dark **mode** and light **mode**. Have you beaten the game on hard **mode**? What's your favorite **mode** of transportation while traveling?
english: a particular means of accomplishing something
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أسلوب

paragraph: No one has been able to **crack** the code. Gas was escaping from a **crack** in the pipe. Would you like to take a **crack** at the job?
english: a thin and usually jagged space opened in a previously solid material

paragraph: All of us want prices to **decline**. His health has begun to **decline**. The economy is expanding after a period of **decline**.
english: to move downwards, to fall, to drop
arabicDesc: مثال: جميعنا يريد أن تنخفض الأسعار.

paragraph: I didn't know who to deliver the **package** to. Did you get the **package** that I sent you? This **package** is a lot heavier than that one.
english: something which is packed, a parcel, a box, an envelope
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: طرد، حزمة، عبوة

paragraph: What makes you so sure it's not a **fake**? The government is **fake**. It doesn't serve the nation. It's difficult to tell an original from a **fake**.
english: not real

paragraph: Does the story have a happy **ending**? Let's get a move on! The break is **ending**. Every **ending** is also a new beginning waiting ahead.
english: the last part of something
arabicDesc: مثال: أللقصّة نهاية سعيدة؟

paragraph: **Knock** on the door before entering the room. Please **knock** before you come in. How many times do I have to tell you to **knock** before you come in?
english: to rap one's knuckles against something
arabicDesc: مثال: اطرق على الباب قبل أن تدخل إلى الغرفة.

paragraph: My team has never **advanced** beyond the quarter-finals. **Advanced** language learning includes learning to talk about politics. The military power of this country is very **advanced**.
english: at or close to the state of the art

paragraph: We didn't see him **anywhere**. You can put it **anywhere**. I never stay **anywhere** long enough to make friends.
english: in or to any place
arabicDesc: مثال: لم نره في أي مكان.

paragraph: It would be **fantastic** if we could do that. The weather at the end of July was **fantastic**. He's the most **fantastic** person of my life.
english: wonderful, marvelous, excellent, extraordinarily good

paragraph: A new hall is built in the **industrial** park. The **Industrial** Revolution changed where and how people lived. **Industrial** countries require a lot of skilled labor.
english: of or relating to industry, notably manufacturing

paragraph: Look at my hair. It's just **terrible**. This is a **terrible** thing. She looks **terrible** in yellow.
english: dreadful; causing alarm or fear
arabicDesc: مثال: أنظر إلى شعري. إنّه فظيع.

paragraph: I got **tired** of lying in bed all day. Being very **tired**, I went to bed early. I am too **tired** to walk any more.
english: in need of rest or sleep
arabicDesc: مثال: تعبت من الرقود في السرير طوال اليوم.

paragraph: Ten teams competed for the **prize**. Either you or I will get the first **prize**. The boy was awarded a **prize** for good conduct.
english: honor or reward striven for in a competitive contest
arabicDesc: مثال: تنافس عشر فرق على الجائزة.

other.meaning: anything captured using the rights of war

paragraph: They debated land **reform** but never carried it out. He decided to stop drinking and **reform** his behavior. The tax **reform** will not touch the banking industry.
english: the change of something that is defective, broken, inefficient or otherwise negative, in order to correct or improve it

paragraph: This is your boarding pass with the **gate** number. Don't forget to shut the **gate**. The **gate** opened all by itself.
english: door-like structure outside
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه هي بطاقتك للرّكوب و هي تحمل رقم البوّابة.

paragraph: Why is there a **bone** in my apple tea? The dog ate the **bone**, which I gave him. How do I know if I've broken a **bone**?
english: a composite material consisting largely of calcium phosphate and collagen and making up the skeleton of most vertebrates
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عضم

paragraph: Police thought of all **possibilities**. There is no **possibility** of the bill being passed. Tonight, there is a **possibility** that it will rain.
english: quality of being possible
arabicDesc: مثال: فكّرت الشّرطة في جميع الاحتمالات.

other.meaning: a thing possible; that which may take place or come into being

paragraph: All animals are **equal**, but some animals are more **equal** than others. Everyone has the right of **equal** access to public service in his country. All men are **equal** before the law... and when placed before a beautiful woman.
english: be equal to
arabicDesc: مثال: كل الحيوانات متساوية، لكن بعضها متساوٍ أكثر من غيرها.

paragraph: How do I feel about my **identity** right now? It is as if we had lost our **identity**. They want to cut us away from our **identity**.
english: sameness, identicalness

other.meaning: the difference or character that marks off an individual or group from the rest

paragraph: I'm sorry to **rush** you. I **rushed** out to see what was going on. **Rush** if you want to make it in time.
english: to hurry
arabicDesc: مثال: آسف للضغط عليك.

other.meaning: The stem of such plants used in making baskets, mats, the seats of chairs, etc (noun)

paragraph: I want to **invest** a little money every month. The government should **invest** more in health and security. This application lets you **invest** in the stock market.
english: to commit resources in the hope of financial gain

paragraph: We should sometimes **expose** our bodies to the sun. She didn't **expose** her skin to the sun. Don't **expose** your skin to the sun for too long.
english: to show something hidden; to put someone in a risky situation

paragraph: His father had served as a United States **senator**. The magazine spread many important charges against the **Senator**. The **senator** has a very demanding schedule this week.
english: a member of the ruler’s council or governing council in general, a leading statesman

other.meaning: member in the house or chamber of a legislature called a senate

paragraph: Why are you touching your **ear**? Don't scream in my **ear**! During his speech she was all **ears**.
english: organ of hearing
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تلمس أذنك؟

paragraph: She advised him not to use too much **sugar**. I had tea without **sugar**, because I want to lose some weight. I forgot to buy **sugar**.
english: sucrose from sugar cane or sugar beet used to sweeten food and drink
arabicDesc: مثال: نصحته بألا يكثر من السكر.

paragraph: It's critical to inform the patient about the **procedure**. You will save time if you adopt this new **procedure**. It's part of police **procedure** to ask that.
english: a particular method for performing a task

paragraph: Let's learn something, like a language for **instance**! This is an **instance** of modern British life. Take, for **instance**, your family problems.
english: an example of something

paragraph: I am not someone who can start out **drama**. Why is there always so much **drama** around you? You want some **drama**? I'll give you some **drama**!
english: composition
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مسرحية

paragraph: The commanding officer led his army into enemy **territory**. The armed forces succeeded in occupying the entire **territory**. They controlled a fifth part of the **territory**.
english: a large extent or tract of land

paragraph: My brother is a member of the rescue **squad**. I want to be assigned to the vice **squad**. He was sentenced to death by firing **squad**.
english: a group of people organized for some common purpose, usually of about ten members
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: جماعة، رهط

paragraph: My wife is **afraid** to drive my new car. I was **afraid** of getting lost in the dark. I am **afraid** I don't agree with you.
english: impressed with fear or apprehension; in fear; apprehensive
arabicDesc: مثال: زوجتي خائفة من قيادة سيارة جديدة.

paragraph: **Environmental** changes are affected by human activity and nature. Oil production in the area carries significant **environmental** consequences. Many European people are aware of **environmental** problems.
english: pertaining to the environment

paragraph: Use positive thinking, and stop doubting your own **intelligence**. I think he has enough **intelligence** to understand it. You don't even know the first thing about **intelligence**.
english: the capacity of mind, especially to understand principles, truths, facts or meanings, acquire knowledge, and apply it to practice
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عقل

paragraph: I noticed that she sat in the front **row**. We went to the lake to **row** a boat. He has been on death **row** for two years.
english: line of objects
arabicDesc: مثال: لاحظت أنها جلست في الصف الأول.

other.meaning: To propel (a boat or other craft) over water using oars (verb)

paragraph: This problem is too difficult for me to **solve**. It is no use trying to **solve** this problem. It is not easy to **solve** the problem.
english: to find an answer or solution
arabicDesc: مثال: من الصعب حل هذه المشكلة.

paragraph: My front **tooth** fell out. It is often said that sweets are bad for your **teeth**. My **tooth** hurts when I try eating ice cream.
english: a hard, calcareous structure present in the mouth of many vertebrate animals, generally used for biting and chewing food
arabicDesc: مثال: وقعت سنّي الأمامية.

paragraph: Reading books **enable** you to travel to another world. How can I **enable** the display of file extensions? Experiments will **enable** you to find out what is wrong.
english: to make it possible for someone to do something

paragraph: It was eight **meters** long. I need some coins to feed the parking **meter**. A **meter** is not quite equivalent to a yard.
english: a device that measures things
arabicDesc: مثال: كان طوله ثمانية أمتار.

paragraph: She's standing next to the **yellow** house. He owns a **yellow** sports car. I'll take the **yellow** one.
english: having yellow as its color
arabicDesc: مثال: هي واقفة بجانب المنزل الأصفر.

paragraph: She **divided** the cake into six pieces. You have to **divide** what's left into four parts. I thought you were going to **divide** up work.
english: split into two or more parts
arabicDesc: مثال: قسمت الكعكة إلى ستة قطع.

paragraph: They **plotted** against the government. The general participated in the **plot** with his men. According to the newspaper, he participated in the **plot**.
english: the course of a story, comprising a series of incidents which are gradually unfolded, sometimes by unexpected means
arabicDesc: مثال: كان يتآمرون ضد الحكومة.

other.meaning: secret plan to achieve an end
participation in any stratagem or conspiracy

paragraph: He needs to look on the **bright** side. The light was very **bright**. You have a **bright** future.
english: emitting much light
arabicDesc: مثال: عليه أن ينظر إلى الجانب المشرق.

other.meaning: having a clear, quick intellect — see also intelligent

paragraph: You must think of this as a great **improvement**. Actually, this method has plenty of room for **improvement**. He stopped smoking for the **improvement** of his health.
english: the act of improving

paragraph: He discussed that **topic** with his son. I think that it won't even be a **topic**. Which type of **topic** is of interest to you?
english: subject; theme
arabicDesc: مثال: ناقش ذلك الموضوع مع ابنه.

paragraph: What's important is not the goal, but the **journey**. She went on a **journey** a few days ago. My life has been a long and structured **journey**.
english: trip, a voyage
arabicDesc: مثال: ما هو مهم ليس الهدف, ولكن الرحلة.

paragraph: He left the **producer** a message on voice mail. I need to find a **producer**. The United States is the largest **producer** of cheese in the world.
english: an individual or organization that creates goods and services

paragraph: Please **inform** me of any change in his condition. Could you **inform** me where to look for water? Did you **inform** your friends of your home-coming?
english: to communicate knowledge to another/others (transitive)
arabicDesc: مثال: الرجاء ابلاغي عن أي تغيير في حالته.

paragraph: He sold me a **chicken**. Does she have a **chicken**? Try getting a dog, a cat or a **chicken**.
english: a domesticated subspecies of red junglefowl (Gallus gallus domesticus)
arabicDesc: مثال: باع لي دجاجة.

paragraph: I don't even know what you are called, **mate**. He was dropped because of his running **mate**. I'll never mention my **mate** to them again.
english: a fellow, comrade, colleague, partner or someone with whom something is shared, e.g. shipmate, classmate

paragraph: We want to hold on to our **ancient** way of life. This doctor practices **ancient** Chinese medicine. I like learning **ancient** languages.
english: having lasted from a remote period
arabicDesc: مثال: نريد التّمسّك بنمط حياتنا القديم.
